rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a close-fitting hat or cap.

example.english: I wore a cap to work today.
example.traditional: 我今日戴咗頂帽去返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 daai3 zo2 deng2 mou2 heoi3 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a removable protective cover or seal, especially on a bottle or container.

example.english: Remember to tighten the bottle cap, or it will leak.
example.traditional: 你記得扭實個樽蓋，唔係會漏水。
example.jyutping: nei5 gei3 dak1 nau2 sat6 go3 zeon1 koi3 m4 hai6 wui5 lau6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for an imposed upper limit such as a salary or spending ceiling.

example.english: The spending cap on this credit card is twenty thousand dollars.
example.traditional: 呢張信用卡嘅消費上限係兩萬蚊。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 seon3 jung6 kaat1 ge3 siu1 fai3 soeng6 haan6 hai6 loeng5 maan6 man1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a dental crown covering a tooth.

example.english: The dentist says this tooth needs a cap.
example.traditional: 牙醫話呢隻牙要裝牙冠。
example.jyutping: ngaa4 ji1 waa6 ni1 zek3 ngaa4 jiu3 zong1 ngaa4 gun1
